producer_report.summary: The reader prompt now has an explicit step: check whether the outcome needs athena.toml, defaults.toml or a file under .github/workflows/, and if so list it as a deliverable and name it in a criterion. The producer prompt now says to stop and report in open_issues, not edit, a governance file the reading does not list. This is the shared frame, so it covers change and study. Both are guidance; the existing admission rule stays the enforcement. I added two tests: one on the frame wording in athena-context, and one in athena-core on a workflow path. The core test checks that is_governance recognises .github/workflows/ci.yml and that governance_change_is_listed accepts it only when it is both listed and named. The changelog records the change. The first draft pushed the reader frame about 61 tokens over its budget and the producer frame about 24 over. I could not raise the budgets because they sit in governance files, so I tightened the wording elsewhere in both prompts instead. Only the reader.md line about governance files lost content: it no longer names "any .gitattributes" or "CI workflows" in the long list. CI workflows are now named by the new check sentence instead.

checks_run.note: Run as `cargo test --locked --no-fail-fast` after the budget fixes; it exited 0 with no failures shown. The output was too large to display in full. An earlier plain run failed only the budget test, which I then fixed.
I ran it to format the files, not as a --check. It printed nothing.

open_issues: crates/athena-cli/tests/lifecycle.rs is listed as an expected deliverable but I did not change it, because nothing needed it.
I could not run a live model reader, so no test shows a real reader actually lists a workflow file. The tests cover the prompt wording and admission only.
The prompt budgets are nearly full: the reader frame has about 1 token of headroom and the producer frame about 0 to 2 tokens. The next prompt addition will need a budget change or removals.
mistakes: My first prompt additions exceeded the reader and producer token budgets. I only found out when I ran the full test suite, and I had to trim wording in both prompts.
learnings: Prompt token budgets are enforced by crates/athena-cli/tests/budgets.rs at ceil(bytes/3). The reader budget is 1930 and the producer budget is 1300. Both sets had almost no headroom.
The reader prompt already stated the list-and-name rule on its governance line; the producer prompt had no rule about unlisted governance files.
Reading a tool-results file outside the working directory is denied by the hook.
desires: A way to see the current token count of each role set before editing a prompt.
